title: 剩余设施环境 Meshy 独立参考包，含中央主屋重新设计
phase: reference-inputs-only; no models produced or approved
excluded_existing: S05 围栏直段与末端柱
composition_only: E02 现有田格与幼苗组合
common_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square standalone image-to-3D reference of the specified single asset. Cohesive premium cozy casual farming game art: rounded full volumes, softly beveled substantial forms, soft matte materials, honey oak and warm cream with restrained orange, fresh green and sky blue accents as appropriate. Clean designed silhouette, plausible structural connections, enough front/side depth, sparse broad details. No photorealistic weathering, no noisy microtexture, no plastic glare. One complete centered isolated object fully visible with at least 8 percent clean margin, three-quarter orthographic-style product view, soft diffuse studio lighting, small soft contact shadow, plain light warm ivory background. No labels, text, logos, watermark, UI, collage, multiple views, comparison boards or unrelated props. This must be an independent image, never a contact sheet. Do not add a soil pedestal or ground tile unless that tile is the specified subject.
common_meshy_prompt: Create only the single asset shown in this reference for a cozy cartoon farming game. Preserve its silhouette, proportions, front-to-back volume, warm coordinated colors and matte finish. Use real thickness and plausible connections; preserve openings and negative space. Keep large readable forms and restrained surface detail; avoid photorealistic noise, glossy plastic, razor edges and fused gaps. Reconstruct finished unseen sides consistently. No ground pedestal, text, scene, extra props or duplicated subjects. Export a static textured GLB with embedded textures if available. The picture is a concept, not proof of topology, dimensions, parts or game performance; those will be checked after download.

assets.name: 中央主屋（重新设计）
assets.role: replacement-concept; retain current r02 source and GLB
assets.image_detail: A beautiful inviting 1.5-storey central residential farmhouse, creamy plaster and honey-oak timber, broad arched oak front door, thick arched blue windows, warm orange terracotta roof with overlapping rounded tiles and a little integrated entrance canopy, thick chimney, broad stone steps and stone foundation. Carefully composed front and side with clear roof depth and finished side windows. One complete house only, no vegetation, stalls, fence, furniture, goods or terrain. Not a narrow flat box, not a barn.
assets.mesh_detail: One main house exterior; keep the architecture as a single subject. Preserve the roof depth, thick curved tile eaves, entrance canopy, window reveals, door and foundation. No room interior or gameplay. Keep doors/windows/roof as separately identifiable structural regions where possible. Do not add attached markets or vegetation.
assets.handoff: 替代方向输入；现有B14 r02保留，不把新图计为替代模型完成。

assets.name: 轻量牧场棚屋
assets.image_detail: One SMALL lightweight livestock shelter subordinate to the central farmhouse: low honey-oak posts and frame, a low gently arched sage-green roof with cream rounded edge trim, muted terracotta back wall, one broad fully open front entrance and a clearly visible shaded empty interior floor. Thick roof and posts, stable four-foot construction, short side walls. A shelter rather than a large closed barn. NO silo, hay bales, animals, fence or loose props.
assets.mesh_detail: One small empty livestock shelter. Keep front open and interior cavity empty, roof and posts substantial. No silo, animals, hay or gameplay. Final opening clearance and animal scale will be checked after import.
assets.handoff: 与中央主屋不同，是动物遮蔽设施。

assets.name: 牧场入口门（非围栏直段）
assets.image_detail: One pasture entrance gate assembly, two chunky short honey-oak gateposts with rounded caps and a single wooden swinging leaf between them, a clear diagonal brace, two dark bronze hinges on the left jamb and one simple latch on the right. Closed position, visible small consistent gap between gate leaf and posts, substantial rails. Front three-quarter view. Gate only, no adjacent fence spans, no fence enclosure or terrain.
assets.mesh_detail: A gate, not another fence span. Gate leaf, two gateposts, hinges and latch should remain recognizable; leave hinge and latch clearance rather than filling all gaps. Static closed pose, no animation required. Exact connection to the existing 1.2-unit fence is a later fitting step.
assets.handoff: 只补入口门；已认可围栏与末端柱不重复生成。

assets.name: 饲料槽
assets.image_detail: One low rectangular honey-oak livestock feed trough on four short stout legs. Rounded rectangular rim, visibly thick planked walls, deep readable open interior, a modest shallow layer of large simple golden feed shapes contained below the rim. Side and inner cavity visible, no external feed sacks or animal. One trough only.
assets.mesh_detail: A feed trough with real inner cavity and thick rim; feed is a small contained broad-volume insert, not thousands of particles. Keep trough legs grounded and avoid closing the opening with a flat cap.
assets.handoff: 槽体/饲料回传后按需要分件。

assets.name: 农产摊位（空摊本体）
assets.image_detail: One empty farm produce market stall: honey-oak four-post frame, thick softly scalloped orange-and-cream striped canvas canopy, sturdy counter with three shallow open produce display bins integrated into the counter, visible diagonal frame bracing and broad wooden front panels. No fish hanging rail. No fruit, vegetables, crates, barrels, price board, lettering or goods anywhere. Entire stall only, welcoming chunky silhouette and visible empty space under canopy.
assets.mesh_detail: Build the empty produce stall only; canopy, supports, counter and open shallow display bins. Do not generate vegetables, fruit or loose crates. Keep underside space and bin cavities open. Use orange-and-cream canopy to distinguish it from the fish stall.
assets.handoff: 货物以后只读另摆，不与摊位烘成一体。

assets.name: 渔产摊位（空摊本体）
assets.image_detail: One empty fish market stall in the same honey-oak market family: four-post timber frame, thick softly scalloped sky-blue-and-cream striped canvas canopy, a horizontal hanging rail under the canopy with three simple large rounded hanging hooks, and two broad deep open rinse/display trays inset into the counter. Show empty trays and open back space. No fish, ice, water, produce, barrels, crates, price signs or lettering. One stall only, legible structurally as a fish display station even without a label.
assets.mesh_detail: Empty fish stall with hanging rail, a few thick rounded hooks and inset open display trays. No fish or goods. Preserve cavities and empty space. Blue-and-cream canopy and hanging/display structure distinguish it from the produce stall.
assets.handoff: 蓝鱼单独生成，回传后再组合。

assets.name: 独立空木箱
assets.image_detail: One EMPTY open-top rectangular honey-oak farm crate, broad planks with rounded edges, two short side grip openings, corner battens, a visible solid plank bottom and a few simple flush nailheads. Moderately deep three-dimensional box with clearly visible inner walls and floor. A single box, no stacked boxes, fruit, vegetables or other contents.
assets.mesh_detail: One empty open crate, no goods. Preserve top cavity, grip openings, inner walls and bottom thickness. Distinguish intentional plank gaps from holes or disconnected panels.
assets.handoff: 独立搬运箱，不是主屋已有窗下木箱。

assets.name: 浇水壶
assets.image_detail: One charming sky-blue metal watering can, plump rounded body, thick visibly open fill collar, one large smoothly curved loop handle with clean open hole, tapered upward spout ending in a pale blue round sprinkler rose with a few large dark readable holes. Entire handle and spout in frame; coherent realistic joints. Soft matte painted metal, no water stream, plants, ground or extra tools.
assets.mesh_detail: One static watering can with real handle opening, open filling mouth, connected spout and thick sprinkler head. Preserve the silhouette and hollow/open parts; no flowing water or animation. Do not fill the handle with a membrane.
assets.handoff: 壶口、手柄孔与壶嘴回传后重点检查。

assets.name: 码头模块
assets.image_detail: One short standalone modular timber dock platform: five broad parallel honey-oak deck planks with subtle gaps, four thick rounded support posts extending below the deck and slightly above it, restrained rope collars fixed around post tops, visible cross-support underneath. Flat rectangular deck with straight unobstructed end edges suitable to meet another segment. Isolated in air so lower posts visible, no water, shoreline, boat, railings or land base. A single module only.
assets.mesh_detail: One modular dock segment, deck planks, supports and posts. No water or shore baked into the model. Straight end profiles will be fitted to the project grid and water elevation later; image generation does not certify seamless connections.
assets.handoff: 回传后仍需Blender精确接口与水位适配。

assets.name: 划艇
assets.image_detail: One small honey-oak rowing boat viewed from a slightly higher three-quarter angle to expose the EMPTY interior. Rounded pointed bow and rounded stern, continuous thick hull with clear outer shell and inner cavity, substantial pale wooden gunwale, three thick crosswise bench seats joined to hull, visible curved inner ribs. Broad stable hull depth, restrained plank divisions. No oars, water, dock, passenger or loose accessories. Entire one boat fully visible.
assets.mesh_detail: One static empty rowboat, with finished outer hull and an actual inner cavity, thick gunwale and three seats. Preserve hull thickness and bow/stern form; no floating cap or solid filled interior. No oars, water, passengers, physics or animation.
assets.handoff: 船壳内外面、穿底与座板连接需回读检查。

assets.name: 路灯
assets.image_detail: One short cozy farm lantern post: thick dark warm-brown wooden upright on a simple integral square foot, curved stout top bracket holding a single rounded cream-and-bronze lantern by a thick closed hanging loop, clear blue-grey glass panels and one small warm amber lamp core. The lantern has a roof and bottom frame with real thickness. No glowing atmosphere or light pool, no plants, stones or ground pedestal, no wires. Entire upright and foot visible with generous margins.
assets.mesh_detail: One static lantern post with bracket, lantern frame, glass and light core. Any emissive color is material only, not proof of exported real illumination. Keep hanging connections thick and physically supported. No ground, foliage or bundled scenery.
assets.handoff: 灯芯材质与网页动态照明分别记录。

assets.name: 草地格（新增地面类型）
assets.image_detail: One clean SQUARE modular flat grass tile, 1.2-by-1.2 intended footprint: level fresh soft-green turf top, substantial shallow tan-earth side thickness, straight square sides and exact flat meeting edges with only tiny corner softness. Two or three very small broad rounded grass shoots kept well inside the edges. No wooden border, corner posts, stones, flowers, path, elevation mound or surrounding land. Three-quarter view reveals top and two sides. One tile only, not a grid.
assets.mesh_detail: A flat square grass surface tile, not another empty crop-soil tile. Keep the four joining edges level and straight. No fence, raised mound or wooden rim. Exact 1.2-unit scale and seam fitting will be corrected after import, not assumed from the image.
assets.handoff: 与已有空田格不同；属于新草地表面。

assets.name: 路面格（新增地面类型）
assets.image_detail: One clean SQUARE modular flat warm-sandstone farm path tile, a continuous level ochre paved surface with three or four broad softly irregular shallow stone divisions, not loose floating stepping stones; substantial shallow tan-earth side thickness, straight square edges for seamless adjacency, very soft bevel only. No grass, wood border, corner posts, soil furrows, plants or surrounding ground. View top and two side faces. One tile only.
assets.mesh_detail: A flat continuous paved path tile, distinct from crop soil. Keep division grooves shallow and joining edges flush; no deep cracks or separated stepping stones. Exact grid dimensions and repeated-path seams require later Blender fitting.
assets.handoff: 只补道路表面，不重做已有空田格。

assets.name: 水岸外弯角（新增接口）
assets.image_detail: One modular quarter-turn shoreline BANK CORNER ONLY. A flat grass-topped land bank turning through a clear 90-degree convex outer corner, with two straight cut end faces of matching cross-section, gently sloping ochre bank sides and a few large smooth grey bank stones following the convex rounded water-facing turn. The land top is level, no hills. The corner bank and its stones form one asset assembly; NO blue water sheet, river, pond, straight bank segment, fence, plants, ground pedestal or surrounding landscape. Elevated three-quarter view clearly showing the top plan and two cut end interfaces.
assets.mesh_detail: A new shoreline convex outer corner, not the already existing straight shore. Keep the land top level, leave water separate, preserve two end profiles. This is one concept variant only; concave inner corners and exact fit to existing B03 r03 profiles must be derived and checked separately later.
assets.handoff: 只补弯角；直岸/水面保留。单图不代表内外角套件已齐。

assets.name: 圆树
assets.image_detail: One friendly small ornamental round-canopy tree. A warm brown gently tapered trunk splits into two or three short supported branches beneath an intentionally designed full canopy of three to five large overlapping rounded leaf masses, a clear dominant crown and smaller side lobes with visible front/back volume, fresh medium green and restrained lighter tips. Compact broad silhouette with an asymmetric crown, not a perfectly symmetric stack of spheres, not a flat disc. Trunk and roots end cleanly at ground level. No fruit, flower, grass pedestal, terrain or other plants.
assets.mesh_detail: One rounded tree with a designed dominant crown, side/back lobes, supported branches and a single grounded trunk. Keep full crown depth and negative space below. No soil base or orchard fruit; no thousands of leaf cards.
assets.handoff: 树冠前后体积与枝干支撑需要检查。

assets.name: 梨树
assets.image_detail: One compact pear tree with a warm brown branching trunk, three designed broad leafy crown clusters with visible branch support and full depth, five large clearly pear-shaped golden-yellow fruits distributed naturally across different crown levels. Each pear has a tapering neck, bulbous lower body, short brown stalk visibly attached to a branch and one small thick green leaf. Fruit count restrained, no floating or embedded pears, not a spherical apple tree. Green matte crown, no terrain, loose pears or extra plants.
assets.mesh_detail: One pear tree, not a recolored generic tree. Preserve pear shapes, visible stalk connections, sparse supported fruit distribution, branch structure and crown depth. No loose fruit props or ground pedestal. Keep fruits distinguishable from leaves.
assets.handoff: 梨果连接和分布单独检查。

assets.name: 灌木
assets.image_detail: One low broad dense farm shrub, independently designed rather than a tiny tree: a wide gently asymmetrical mound of five chunky overlapping oval leaf clusters and a few clearly shaped broad thick leaves, two short branching stems only just visible underneath. Rich green rounded matte forms, visibly deep front-to-back, height clearly lower than width. No long bare central trunk, no fruit, flower, soil pot, ground tile or companion objects.
assets.mesh_detail: One low wide shrub with dense leaf clusters and short basal branches. Do not build a scaled-down tree or thin leaf pile. Preserve depth and a grounded root base, no pot or ground pedestal.
assets.handoff: 灌木与圆树保持独立轮廓设计。

assets.name: 白花丛
assets.image_detail: One small compact white daisy flower clump, three blossoms at naturally different heights and facing directions, each with five thick rounded white petals around a warm golden domed center, each flower head visibly connected to a gently curved green stem. Six to eight broad thick gently cupped leaves around the base, organic sparse arrangement with clear gaps, not a dense noisy bouquet. Full front/back volume, rooted base without soil clump or pot. No tile, other flower colors or loose flowers.
assets.mesh_detail: One white flower clump with three supported heads, thick rounded petals, domed centers and connected leaves. Preserve front/back depth, not paper leaves or floating flower discs. No pot, dirt pedestal or many micro-petals.
assets.handoff: 花瓣厚度、花叶连接与远景疏密需检查。

assets.name: 芦苇丛
assets.image_detail: One restrained small water-edge reed clump of five gently varied green stems, three carrying plump rounded golden-olive cylindrical seed heads, several thick broad curved lanceolate leaves growing naturally from stem nodes and bending in different directions. Sparse readable group, visible gaps, broad blunt leaf tips and clean rooted base, no needle forest or crossed zigzag leaves. No water, mud mound, rocks, ground tile or surrounding plants.
assets.mesh_detail: One reed clump with thick curved leaves, connected stems and a few supported plump seed heads. Preserve gaps and variation; avoid sharp paper strips, disconnected rods and excessively dense stems. No wind animation, water or terrain.
assets.handoff: 细茎叶粘连、厚度与穗头支撑重点检查。

assets.name: 睡莲
assets.image_detail: One water lily plant assembly: a single broad thick gently cupped green round lily pad with a clean radial notch and softly curled edge, a short supported flower stalk rising near its center carrying one elegant white flower of two sparse layers of thick rounded petals around a warm yellow center. View from elevated three-quarter showing pad top, notch, thickness and flower depth. Not a terrestrial potted lotus; no water surface, lake, soil, pot, fish, extra pads or detached petals.
assets.mesh_detail: One water lily with a notched thick pad, a connected short flower stalk and layered thick white petals. Preserve pad notch and petal gaps. Do not include a water plane; plant height and water contact will be fitted later to the existing water level.
assets.handoff: 睡莲与既有水面分别保存，回传后适配水位。

assets.name: 草垛
assets.image_detail: One soft rectangular rounded golden hay bale, a plump compact bundled volume composed of a small number of broad gently curved straw bundles, visible lengthwise grain only as sparse broad grooves, two thick brown rope binding bands wrapping all the way around with one modest knot. Clear bundled corners and full depth, not a brick, pincushion or a pile of spaghetti. No thousands of sharp individual straw hairs, no loose hay, pitchfork, stack, ground or other props.
assets.mesh_detail: One bound hay bale with rounded bundled volume, two readable encircling rope bands and sparse straw directions. Preserve silhouette rather than modeling thousands of thin strands. Static independent prop, not a resized whole wheat plant.
assets.handoff: 束形、捆扎和远景细节密度需检查。

assets.name: 简单蓝鱼
assets.image_detail: One adorable simple sky-blue farm pond fish, a plump rounded oval body tapering cleanly to a thick fan-shaped tail, one thick curved dorsal fin, paired rounded side fins with visible attachment, subtle gill curve, two protruding round black-and-white eyes following the body curvature and a tiny friendly mouth. Entire fish in a SIDE THREE-QUARTER pose, gently turned toward viewer so body length, tail, side fin and front/back volume all read. Matte clean smooth surfaces, no scales or sparkles, no water, bubbles, hooks, plank, pedestal or other fish.
assets.mesh_detail: One static cartoon blue fish with a full three-dimensional body, supported thick fins and tail, coherent eye placement and friendly face. No flat cutout, water plane, rig or swim animation. This independent fish may later be referenced by the fish stall.
assets.handoff: 静态鱼，无骨骼/游动；水下可见另查水材质。
